1501.meaning1: of another religion; believing in others

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

1502.meaning2: asking for something else; exchanging for something else (?)

1503.meaning1: rule about exchanging for something else

examples.text: saṅghassa pariṇataṃ aññasaṅghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. cetiyassa pariṇataṃ aññacetiyassa vā saṅghassa vā puggalassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākummakulaṃ ciranivāsī ahosi.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.

evaṃ sammā dvayat'ānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā'ti.
kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti
yasmiṃ kho, vaccha, samaye imañ'ca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anupapanno hoti, tam'ahaṃ taṇh'ūpādānaṃ vadāmi. taṇhā hi'ssa, vaccha, tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī'ti.

1510.meaning1: some or other; some or other kind of

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, soko? yo kho, bhikkhave, aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, soko.
uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi, yadā'yaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmī'ti.

1524.meaning1: who belongs to another sect; who follows another religion

examples.text: imesam'pi candimasūriyānaṃ evaṃmah'iddhikānaṃ evaṃmah'ānubhāvānaṃ tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyeyyātha, ko pana vādo aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānan'ti!
sace, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kiṃmūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, kiṃsambhavā sabbe dhammā, kiṃsamudayā sabbe dhammā, kiṃsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā

1525.meaning1: who belonged to another sect before; who previously followed another religion

examples.text: yo kho, sabhiya, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati.

1526.meaning2: Chapter 5 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
1526.meaningLit: section on followers of other religions with elided repetitions

1527.meaning1: ascetics, priests, and wanderers of other religions
1527.construction:
aññatitthiya + samaṇabrāhmaṇa + paribbājaka + ā
aññatitthiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājaka + ā
1527.commentary: (SNa) pariyosāne pana aññatitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakānaṃ adhigamo'ti bāhirakānaṃ sabbo'pi guṇ'ādhigamo paṭhamamaggena adhigataguṇānaṃ satabhāgam'pi sahassabhāgam'pi satasahassabhāgam'pi na upagacchatī'ti.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa adhigamaṃ upanidhāya aññatitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakānaṃ adhigamo n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti. evaṃ mah'ādhigamo, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo, evaṃ mah'ābhiñño'ti.

1528.meaningLit: discourse on followers of other religion

1529.meaningLit: discourse on followers of other religion

examples.text: na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhim'āha, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto, attañ'jaho na'y'idha pakubbamāno.
ajjhattam'ev'upasame, na aññato bhikkhu santim'eseyya, ajjhattaṃ upasantassa, n'atthi attāṃ kuto nirattāṃ vā.

1531.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of añña
1531.meaning1: as another; as something else; as not oneself

examples.text: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya sabbanimittāni aññato passati

1532.meaning1: elsewhere; in other places; somewhere else (than)

examples.text: na aññatra, bhagavā, tava sāsanā, na aññattha, sugata, tava sāsanā, yadagge ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati ekantikato abhippasanno, tadagge ahaṃ, bhante, dīgharattaṃ avinipāto avinipātaṃ sañjānāmi, āsā ca pana me santiṭṭhati sakadāgāmitāya.
kāsattam'iti bhāvaniddesena aññatth'āpi s'āgamo hoti. ahosi, adāsi.

1533.meaning1: having another teacher; following another doctrine
1533.commentary: (MNa) aññatr'ācariyakenā'ti paccay'ākāraṃ ajānantānaṃ aññesaṃ ācariyānaṃ santike vasantena.

examples.text: gambhīro h'āyaṃ, vaccha, dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakk'āvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo. so tayā dujjāno aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrayogena aññatth'ācariyakena.

1534.meaning1: except at the right time; other than at the correct occasion

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhun'upassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānā hoti bhikkhunī, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho ete'y'eva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
ajja't'agge dān'āhaṃ, āvuso ānanda, aññatr'eva bhagavatā aññatra bhikkhusaṅghena uposathaṃ karissāmi saṅghakammañ'cā'ti
ajānam'evaṃ āvuso avacaṃ jānāmi, apassaṃ passāmi, tucchaṃ musā vilapin'ti, aññatra adhimānā, ayam'pi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
na h'eva saccāni bahūni nānā, aññatra saññāya niccāni loke, takkañ'ca diṭṭhīsu pakappayitvā, saccaṃ musā'ti dvayadhammam'āhu.

1537.meaning1: with a different religious practice; having devotion elsewhere; practising another discipline
1537.meaning2: following another discipline or religious practice

examples.text: gambhīro h'āyaṃ, vaccha, dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakk'āvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo. so tayā dujjāno aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrayogena aññatr'ācariyakena.

1539.meaning1: following another school; belonging to another teaching

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

1540.meaning1: with different religious practice; having devotion elsewhere; practising elsewhere

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

1541.meaning1: without; nothing to do (with); completely separate (from)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi, yaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehī'ti?
yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.

rañño'pi kho, bhikkhave, pasenadissa kosalassa atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo. evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako tasmim'pi nibbindati. tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pag'eva hīnasmiṃ.
tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇāni. katamāni tīṇi? uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati. imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇānī'ti.

1543.meaning1: change of mind; change of mental state; change of opinion

examples.text: tattha appasannā c'eva nappasīdanti, pasannānañ'ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamo asamayo padhānāya.
tatra, sunakkhatta, yam'pi tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti, dhammaṃ nesaṃ desessan'ti tassa'pi hoti aññathattan'ti.

1544.meaning1: one thing… another; in one way… in another way

examples.text: aññathā kho, cunda, brāhmaṇā pacchābhūmakā kamaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā aggiparicārikā udak'orohakā soceyyāni paññapenti, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hotī'ti
aññathā santam'attānaṃ, aññathā yo pavedaye, nikacca kitavass'eva, bhuttaṃ theyyena tassa taṃ.
tassa, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti.
aññathā kho, cunda, brāhmaṇā pacchābhūmakā kamaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā aggiparicārikā udak'orohakā soceyyāni paññapenti, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hotī'ti
yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā, etādiso vinābhāvo, passa lokassa pariyāyaṃ.
paroparañ'ca jānāsi, atho rāgavirāginaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, sattānaṃ āgatiṃ gatin'ti.

1549.meaning1: different in character; unalike in nature

examples.text: aññe, bhante, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā, añño'ham'asmi. aññathādhammā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā, aññathādhammo'ham'asmī'ti.
alaṃ, ānanda, mā soci mā paridevi nanu etaṃ, ānanda, mayā paṭikacc'eva akkhātaṃ sabbeh'eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo
tassa rūpa-vipariṇāma-aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

1552.meaning1: different existence; being elsewhere; another state of existence

examples.text: jātimaraṇasaṃsāraṃ, ye vajanti punappunaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, avijjāy'eva sā gati.
cakkhu aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. rūpā aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. itth'etaṃ dvayaṃ calañ'c'eva byathañ'ca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.
sotaviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvi yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo sotaviññāṇassa aññathābhāvi uppādāya so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvi.

1554.meaning1: with different opinions; with other ideas

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? aññathāsaññino'pi h'ettha, cunda, sant'eke sattā. imāya'pi kho ahaṃ, cunda, paññattiyā n'eva attanā samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo.

1555.meaning1: seeing the qualities of the teacher in a different way

1556.commentary: (ANa) aññathā'smī'ti idaṃ pana asamato gahaṇaṃ, yath'āyaṃ khattiyo yath'āyaṃ brāhmaṇo, tato aññathā ahaṃ, hīno vā adhiko vā'ti attho.

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, sati itth'asmī'ti hoti, evaṃ'smī'ti hoti, aññathā'smī'ti hoti, as'asmī'ti hoti, sat'asmī'ti hoti, santi hoti, itthaṃ santi hoti, evaṃ santi hoti, aññathā santi hoti

1558.meaning1: for another purpose; for the benefit of another

examples.text: tatra bhikkhu vivekaninnena cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vivek'aṭṭhena nekkhamm'ābhiratena añña'd'atthu uyyojanika-paṭisaṃyuttaṃ'y'eva kathaṃ kattā hoti
tassa mayhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ añña'd'atthu bhayapaṭikaṅkhī viharāmi?

1561.meaning1: on the contrary; however; on the other hand

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo sakapitu nivesane n'eva dānaṃ alattha na paccakkhānaṃ, añña'd'atthu akkosam'eva alattha
añña'd'atthu pañjaliko'va naṃ yācati, dehi me, mārisa, urabbhaṃ vā urabbhadhanaṃ vā'ti.

1563.notes: A Sanskrit term composed of ājñā (ā + √jñā) order/command, draṣṭu a vedic infinitive form (short for draṣṭum = 'in order to see', from √dṛś), and darśa one who sees (from √dṛś). The compound is an adjective of Brahmā, and means 'one who, by his order/command, is capable of seeing (anything that can be seen)'.

examples.text: eso hi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu'daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ.

1564.commentary: (DNa) añña'd'atthuharo'ti sayaṃ tucchahattho āgantvā ek'aṃsena yaṃkiñci harati'y'eva. (DNa) añña'd'atthuharo hotī'ti ek'aṃsena hārako'y'eva hoti. sahāyassa gehaṃ rittahattho āgantvā nivatthasāṭak'ādīnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, so ativiya tvaṃ samma imassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsasī'ti aññaṃ nivāsetvā taṃ deti.

examples.text: cattāro'me, gahapatiputta, amittā mittapatirūpakā veditabbā. añña'd'atthuharo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.

1565.meaning1: on another day; at another time
1565.meaning2: on another day, at another time

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā thero āyasmantaṃ isidattaṃ etadavoca, sādhu kho taṃ, āvuso isidatta, eso pañho paṭibhāsi, n'eso pañho maṃ paṭibhāsi. tenah'āvuso isidatta, yadā aññadā'pi evarūpo pañho āgaccheyya, taññ'ev'ettha paṭibhāseyyā'ti.

1566.meaning1: having another view; believing in something else; holding a different opinion

1569.meaning2: wishing for knowledge, wanting to know

1570.meaning2: wishing for knowledge, wanting to know

1571.meaning1: (vinaya) belonging to another class; connected with another category (of offences or issues)
1571.commentary: (VIN 1.2.9) kathaṃ āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ āpatt'ādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyaṃ? methunadhammapārājik'āpatti methunadhamma-pārājik'āpattiyā tabbhāgiyā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti

1572.meaning1: and if really belonging to another class; even if connected with another category

examples.text: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā aññabhāgiyañ'c'eva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti kocideso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅgh'ādiseso.

1573.meaning1: mutual; one another; one to another

examples.text: saṅghe kho pana, bhikkhave, bhinne aññam'aññaṃ akkosā ca honti, aññam'aññaṃ paribhāsā ca honti, aññam'aññaṃ parikkhepā ca honti, aññam'aññaṃ pariccajā ca honti.
phandamānaṃ pajaṃ disvā, macche app'odake yathā, aññam'aññehi byāruddhe, disvā maṃ bhayam'āvisi.
na h'ettha, bhikkhave, atthi dhammacariyā, samacariyā, kusalakiriyā, puññakiriyā. aññam'aññakhādikā ettha, bhikkhave, vattati dubbalakhādikā. taṃ kissa hetu?

1575.meaning1: fact of mutual dependence; state of interdependence
1575.meaning2: fact of mutual dependence; state of interdependence

examples.text: ettāvatā adhivacanapatho, ettāvatā niruttipatho, ettāvatā paññattipatho, ettāvatā paññ'āvacaraṃ, ettāvatā vaṭṭaṃ vattati itthattaṃ paññāpanāya yadidaṃ nāmarūpaṃ saha viññāṇena aññam'aññapaccayatā pavattati.

1576.meaning1: each other's; one of the other

examples.text: pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti.

1577.commentary: (KVa) tena yaṃ idaṃ aññam'aññassa hitavacanaṃ, āpattito ca vuṭṭhāpanaṃ, tena aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanena

examples.text: bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena, evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanenā'ti

1578.meaning1: helping to rehabilitate each other; mutual support
1578.meaningLit: causing one another to stand up
1578.commentary: (KVa) tena yaṃ idaṃ aññam'aññassa hitavacanaṃ, āpattito ca vuṭṭhāpanaṃ, tena aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanena.

examples.text: bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena, evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanenā'ti

te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.

1580.commentary: (VINa) aññam'aññ'ānulomatā'ti aññam'aññaṃ vattuṃ anulomabhāvo. vadantu maṃ āyasmanto'ti hi vadantaṃ sakkā hoti kiñci vattuṃ, na itaraṃ.

1581.meaning1: they are jealous of each other; they envy each other; they covet one another's (wealth)

examples.text: mahaddhanā mahābhogā, raṭṭhavanto'pi khattiyā, aññam'aññ'ābhigijjhanti, kāmesu analaṅ'katā.
hit'ānukampī sambuddho, yadaññam'anusāsati, anurodhavirodhehi, vippamutto tathāgato'ti.

1583.meaning1: not harming another; not troubling others; not disturbing another

examples.text: kummo'va aṅgāni sake kapāle, samodahaṃ bhikkhu manovitakke, anissito aññam'aheṭhayāno, parinibbuto n'ūpavadeyya kañcī'ti.

1584.meaning1: emancipation by another person; being freed by someone else
1584.commentary: (NIDD1) na hi aññamokkhā'ti te attanā palipapalipannā na sakkonti paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharituṃ. (SNPa) na hi aññamokkhā'ti aññena ca mocetuṃ na sakkonti. kāraṇavacanaṃ vā etaṃ, te sattā duppamuñcā. kasmā? yasmā aññena mocetabbā na honti. yadi pana muñceyyuṃ, sakena thāmena muñceyyun'ti ayam'assa attho.

examples.text: icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.

1585.meaning1: with other preferences; with different inclinations

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

1586.commentary: (VINa) saṅghassa pariṇataṃ aññasaṅghassā'ti ekasmiṃ vihāre saṅghassa pariṇataṃ aññaṃ vihāraṃ uddisitvā asukasmiṃ nāma mahāvihāre saṅghassa dethā'ti pariṇāmeti.

examples.text: saṅghassa pariṇataṃ aññasaṅghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. cetiyassa pariṇataṃ aññacetiyassa vā saṅghassa vā puggalassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

1587.meaning1: perceiving as something else; regarding (something) as another

examples.text: vandāhi [vandāhi evañ'ca vadehi (sabbattha) aññasuttesu pana n'atthi]

1589.meaning1: sake of someone else; for another person
1589.commentary: (VINa) aññass'atthāyā'ti kuṭilakkhaṇappattam'pi kuṭiṃ aññassa upajjhāyassa vā ācariyassa vā saṅghassa vā atthāya karontassa anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, rasarase, ñātakānaṃ pavāritānaṃ, aññass'atthāya, attano dhanena, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

1590.meaning1: like of another (person); similar to another
1590.commentary: (THa) aññass'eva sarāmi attānan'ti imaṃ mama attabhāvaṃ aññassa sattassa viya sarāmi upadhāremi sañjānāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: abhisatto'va nipatati, vayo rūpaṃ aññam'iva tath'eva santaṃ, tass'eva sato avippavasato, aññass'eva sarāmi attānan'ti.

1591.meaning2: who speaks about something else, prevaricator

1594.commentary: (VINa) ettha aññaṃ vadatī'ti aññavādakaṃ, aññen'aññaṃ paṭicaraṇass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: aññavādake, vihesake pācittiyaṃ.

1595.meaning1: rule about evading the subject; Pācittiya 12

1596.meaning1: rule about asking for something else

1597.meaning1: engaged with something else; preoccupied with another activity; (comm) thinking about something else
1597.meaning2: being occupied with something else, distracted

examples.text: anāpatti yo koci viññū dutiyo hoti, tiṭṭhati na nisīdati, araho'pekkho, aññavihito nisīdati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

1598.meaning1: connected with something else; about another thing
1598.commentary: (DNa) aññavihitakena ñāṇadassanenā'ti paccakkhaṃ viya katvā dassanasamatthatāya dassanabhūtena ñāṇena aññatthavihitakena ñāṇena aññaṃ ārabbha pavattena, aññavihitakaṃ aññaṃ ārabbha pavattamānaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ saṅgāhetabbaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ maññanti. (NIDD1a) aññavihitakā'ti aññen'ākārena ṭhitā.

examples.text: te ca aññatitthiyā paribbājakā aññavihitakena ñāṇadassanena aññavihitakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ maññanti yatha'r'iva bālā abyattā.
atha vā ye te kilesā aññajātikā aññavihitakā, ime vuccanti ye c'āpi dhammā.
